# The 5E (2024) spell deck

The English spells, items and features in this folder on poker cards,
the spells first. Nine cards fill one A4 sheet; Wildfire Storm is too
long for one card and takes two.

```cardsmith-deck
system: 5e_2024
card-type: [spell, item, generic]
card-languages: en
paper-size: A4 portrait
```
